diff --git a/docs/product/axiom-master-action-plan.md b/docs/product/axiom-master-action-plan.md
index 932471dd..e2f07f12 100644
--- a/docs/product/axiom-master-action-plan.md
+++ b/docs/product/axiom-master-action-plan.md
@@ -236,6 +236,7 @@ Use purposeful, restrained animation to make Axiom’s marketing site feel premi
 - **React Bits:** Evaluate and pilot only selected components adapted to Axiom’s own style. Review the exact component/version license, including any Commons Clause or other commercial-use restrictions, before adoption; do not assume suitability or install automatically.
 - **GSAP:** Evaluate advanced interactions, coordinated motion and polished product demonstrations where simpler CSS is insufficient and the added complexity is warranted. Review the exact package/version license and any proposed Codex-compatible skill before adoption under the third-party workflow above.
 - **Lenis:** Keep native scrolling by default. Consider a limited marketing-site trial only if it demonstrably improves the experience without harming keyboard navigation, accessibility or performance.
+- **GetLayers AI (https://www.getlayers.ai):** Evaluate as a premium website-design reference and optional design accelerator alongside Prompt Motion. Explore its templates, hero sections, gradients, 3D scenes, backgrounds, interactive sections, AI design tools and editable Figma workflow for original Axiom marketing concepts. Prioritize restrained dark enterprise visuals, authentic product/governance storytelling, responsive layouts and fast accessible rendering; avoid decorative 3D or copied template identity. Pilot one isolated hero or workflow section using free/reference materials first; review actual output, provenance, commercial licensing, performance, security and maintainability before integrating. GetLayers offers an MCP connector for Codex and other MCP-capable clients, but it may require a paid Full Stack plan; do not purchase, connect an account, install a remote MCP server or import unreviewed code without separate approval. Keep existing Axiom design tokens, framework and B6 acceptance gates. This is evaluation scope, not an installation or adoption claim.
 - **Prompt Motion (https://prompt-motion.com):** Use as a motion-design inspiration and research reference for the marketing website, including hero sequences, kinetic typography, product transitions and interactive storytelling. Develop original Axiom-branded concepts for deployment pipelines, approval gates, audit trails, rollback and authentic product demonstrations. Implement only justified effects with approved CSS, GSAP or Motion for React; review licensing and provenance before using any example code or assets. Do not copy third-party designs or claim reference examples are production-ready. Apply the existing reduced-motion, accessibility, desktop/mobile performance and B6 Playwright acceptance requirements. This reference does not authorize installation, purchases or deployment.
 - **Accessibility and performance:** Respect reduced-motion preferences, provide a usable reduced-motion experience, and avoid motion that obscures content or delays interaction. Test desktop and mobile responsiveness, scrolling, focus behavior, animation smoothness, loading and interaction performance before accepting an effect. Retain only effects with a clear benefit within agreed performance budgets.
